verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that ElevenLabs Agents can connect to external MCP servers and use them to access and process information from data sources, so the product itself acts as an MCP client. The evidence pack does not explicitly document invoking the server's tools, and it gives no setup, transport, auth, or approval details and no independent corroboration, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: explicit documentation of invoking MCP server tools (not just accessing data), transport/auth/configuration details, tool approval or permission controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: ElevenLabs allows you to connect your conversational agents to external MCP servers.
Access and process information from various data sources via the MCP server
